answer: A newcomer starts on one small knoll and earns standing only by publishing a fresh cipher for each real job: a short proof, generated from that job's own data, that strangers can check without trusting the author. The horizon of full privileges opens only after ciphers arrive from many unrelated knolls over a whole season, each tied to a different stranger's need. A Sybil farm fails because its copies all crack the same cipher pattern at the same hour, and identical proofs expose the cluster at once; one failed or copied cipher burns that knoll, and the agent must start a new one alone.
